from pathlib import Path
import math
D=[]
for l in Path('/app/graphene.dat').read_text().splitlines():
    x,y=[float(z.strip().replace(',','.')) for z in l.split('\t')]
    D.append((x,y))

def solve(A,b):
    n=len(b); M=[list(map(float,A[i]))+[float(b[i])] for i in range(n)]
    for k in range(n):
        p=max(range(k,n),key=lambda i:abs(M[i][k]))
        if abs(M[p][k])<1e-14: return None
        M[k],M[p]=M[p],M[k]
        q=M[k][k]
        for j in range(k,n+1): M[k][j]/=q
        for i in range(n):
            if i==k: continue
            q=M[i][k]
            if q:
                for j in range(k,n+1): M[i][j]-=q*M[k][j]
    return [M[i][n] for i in range(n)]

def linfit(x,y,cols):
    # cols list columns each point; return coeff,sse
    n=len(cols); m=len(cols[0])
    AtA=[[sum(cols[i][k]*cols[i][j] for i in range(n)) for j in range(m)] for k in range(m)]
    Atb=[sum(cols[i][k]*y[i] for i in range(n)) for k in range(m)]
    p=solve(AtA,Atb)
    if p is None:return None,1e99
    sse=sum((sum(p[j]*cols[i][j] for j in range(m))-y[i])**2 for i in range(n))
    return p,sse

def obj(par,data,deg):
    x0,lg=par; g=math.exp(lg)
    if not (min(x for x,y in data)-2*g <= x0 <= max(x for x,y in data)+2*g): return 1e99
    xref=sum(x for x,y in data)/len(data); span=max(x for x,y in data)-min(x for x,y in data)
    xs=[(x-xref)/span for x,y in data]
    ys=[y for x,y in data]
    cols=[]
    for (x,y),u in zip(data,xs):
      peak=1/(1+((x-x0)/g)**2)
      cols.append([u**j for j in range(deg+1)]+[peak])
    p,sse=linfit(xs,ys,cols)
    return sse

def nm(data,deg,x0,g):
    z=[x0,math.log(g)]
    step=[max(1,g*.1),.25]
    simplex=[z[:],[z[0]+step[0],z[1]],[z[0],z[1]+step[1]]]
    vals=[obj(q,data,deg) for q in simplex]
    for it in range(1000):
      order=sorted(range(3),key=lambda i:vals[i]); simplex=[simplex[i] for i in order];vals=[vals[i] for i in order]
      if max(abs(vals[i]-vals[0])/(1+vals[0]) for i in range(1,3))<1e-13 and max(abs(simplex[i][j]-simplex[0][j]) for i in range(1,3) for j in range(2))<1e-8:break
      cen=[(simplex[0][j]+simplex[1][j])/2 for j in range(2)]
      refl=[cen[j]+(cen[j]-simplex[2][j]) for j in range(2)]; vr=obj(refl,data,deg)
      if vals[0]<=vr<vals[1]: simplex[2]=refl;vals[2]=vr;continue
      if vr<vals[0]:
        exp=[cen[j]+2*(refl[j]-cen[j]) for j in range(2)];ve=obj(exp,data,deg)
        if ve<vr:simplex[2]=exp;vals[2]=ve
        else:simplex[2]=refl;vals[2]=vr
        continue
      con=[cen[j]+.5*(simplex[2][j]-cen[j]) for j in range(2)];vc=obj(con,data,deg)
      if vc<vals[2]:simplex[2]=con;vals[2]=vc;continue
      simplex[1]=[simplex[0][j]+.5*(simplex[1][j]-simplex[0][j]) for j in range(2)]
      simplex[2]=[simplex[0][j]+.5*(simplex[2][j]-simplex[0][j]) for j in range(2)]
      vals[1]=obj(simplex[1],data,deg);vals[2]=obj(simplex[2],data,deg)
    q=simplex[0];x0=q[0];g=math.exp(q[1]);
    xref=sum(x for x,y in data)/len(data); span=max(x for x,y in data)-min(x for x,y in data)
    xs=[(x-xref)/span for x,y in data]; ys=[y for x,y in data]
    cols=[]
    for (x,y),u in zip(data,xs): cols.append([u**j for j in range(deg+1)]+[1/(1+((x-x0)/g)**2)])
    p,sse=linfit(xs,ys,cols)
    # p baseline coeff and peak amp
    return x0,g,p[-1],p[0],sse,len(data),it

# sort ascending
D.sort()
for name,lo,hi,guess,gg in [('2D',15600,16800,16250,250),('2D narrow',15800,16650,16250,250),('2D very',15900,16550,16250,250),('G',16800,18400,17700,400),('G narrow',17000,18200,17700,400),('G very',17200,18100,17700,400)]:
 dat=[q for q in D if lo<=q[0]<=hi]
 print('\n',name,len(dat),lo,hi)
 for deg in (0,1,2):
  try:print('deg',deg,nm(dat,deg,guess,gg))
  except Exception as e:print('ERR',e)

    return linfit([(x-xref)/span for x,y in data],[y for x,y in data],cols)[1]

for lo,hi in [(14500,21000),(15000,20500),(15500,20500),(15800,20500),(16000,20500),(16500,20500)]:
